purpose: Full Sunray150 150.dae visible plus standalone Livox MID-360 mount audit. This is a manual review scene, not a final runtime asset.

aircraft.visibility_rule: aircraft frame, cameras, boards, connectors, cables, brackets, protection arcs, and non-propeller parts are kept visible; only user-confirmed DAE propeller pattern objects are removed
aircraft.material_rule: Component-name-driven material assignment based on the local DAE probe: carbon frame, plastic brackets/rings, black/green PCB, USB/HDMI shells, rubber cables, camera bodies/lenses, TF Mini, motor bell/copper windings, steel screws, aluminum standoffs.

mid360.orientation_rule: yaw=270deg; user requested rotating the previous yaw=180deg radar pose by +90deg for direction audit
mid360.scale_rule: Import at base visual scale 1.2, then directly fit the four user-identified MID-360 mount-hole object centers 000..003 to the four user-selected frame holes.
mid360.placement_rule: XY is fitted from the four named MID-360 mount-hole object centers; Z snaps full visual bottom to selected top-panel z plane.
mid360.material_rule: MID-360 uses per-submesh texture materials: 015 glossy blue optical window, 013/014 dark semi-metallic housing, 016 black base, 017 and rear details black M12 connector, 000..003 black mount inserts, 004..007 dark metal bosses.

propellers.source_rule: Use sunray150_with_mid360/meshes/sunray_cw.stl as the required three-blade propeller source; DAE propeller objects remain deleted.
propellers.placement_rule: Fit the two detected STL screw holes (0,+/-2.5,2.5 mm) to each DAE M2x8 screw pair. Scale correction is applied only from screw-hole distance ratio.
propellers.z_rule: Final propeller transform translation.z is computed from user-audited planes and fine tune: base -0.0161m + ((-0.0193m + 0.0001m) - -0.021098m) + 0.00015m = -0.014052m.
propellers.orientation_warning: Hole fitting alone does not decide propeller front/back side. User manually accepted flipped_around_screw_axis; candidates mode remains available for future review.
propellers.screw_source: DAE SCREW_BUTTON_HEAD_M2_8MM.1..8 nearest two screws per SDF rotor center

material_detail_overlays.overlay_rule: Review decals and cable hints are non-physical texture intent markers: LIVOX/MID-360 logo, YUN DRONE/LAVA motor marks, motor gold rim cues, USB camera lens glass, and colored cable sleeves. They do not alter accepted MID-360/propeller placement.

visibility.visibility: realistic material review: full assembly visible; audit markers hidden by default

review_instruction: User audits radar x/y/z placement, connector direction, radar scale, and later four official tri-blade propeller shaft/hole alignment. In radar_mount view, non-radar clutter and propellers are hidden only for review.

camera.lighting: area key light plus soft fill light for visible reflections on glass, metal, and carbon-fiber materials
